A word in isolation is almost meaningles.src: A word in isolation is almost meaningless. Consider the word bank. Is it a river bank or a money bank? The word alone can't tell you—you have to look at its neighbors.

Self-attention is how Transformers let e.zh:
自注意力机制正是 Transformer 让每个词 @@T0@@向周围询问@@T1@@ 的方式。
          句子中的每个词都向其余所有词发问：“我应当
          在多大程度上关注你？”答案以一个介于 0 与 1 之间的数值返回。
          随后每个词以邻词含义的加权混合来重建自身。
Self-attention is how Transformers let e.src: Self-attention is how Transformers let each word ask around. Every word in a sentence says to every other word: "Hey, how much should I care about you?" The answer comes back as a single number between 0 and 1. Then each word rebuilds itself as a weighted mix of its neighbors' meanings.

Each is a linear projection of the same input embedding $x_i \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{\text{model}}}$. Three matrices $W_Q, W_K, W_V$ are learned once, shared across every position:

Same input, three different rotations. T.src:
Same input, three different rotations. The query rotation pulls
          out the "what am I looking for?" features, the key rotation
          pulls out the "what do I advertise?" features, and the value
          rotation pulls out "what do I deliver if attended to?". One word
          plays three roles because three separate matrices were trained to
          read it three different ways.

@@T0@@Why three matrices and not one?@@T.zh:
@@T0@@为何需要三个矩阵而非一个？@@T1@@
          单次旋转一次只能表达一种特征视角。借助
          三个相互独立的矩阵，模型可以同时让一个词
          “请求动词”、“展示为与水相关的名词”，以及
          “交付地理含义”——三项正交的任务，
          落在三个正交的子空间中。
@@T0@@Why three matrices and not one?@@T.src: Why three matrices and not one? A single rotation can express one feature view at a time. With three independent matrices, the model can simultaneously make a word "ask for verbs", "advertise as a water-related noun", and "deliver geography content" — three orthogonal jobs in three orthogonal subspaces.

How do we measure how well a Query match.src: How do we measure how well a Query matches a Key? We use the dot product. If the two vectors point the same way, the score is large and positive. If they're perpendicular, zero. If they point opposite ways, negative.

@@T0@@Scaled dot product in real Transfo.zh:
@@T0@@真实 Transformer 中的缩放点积。@@T1@@
          在实际实现中，点积会除以
          $\sqrt{d_k}$（其中 $d_k$ 为 key 的维度）。当维度
          很大时，原始点积会急剧膨胀，把 softmax 压成 one-hot。
          该缩放因子使梯度保持健康。在二维情形下我们将其忽略，

@@T0@@Scaled dot product in real Transfo.src: Scaled dot product in real Transformers. In production, the dot product is divided by $\sqrt{d_k}$ (where $d_k$ is the key dimension). With large dimensions, raw dot products balloon and squash softmax to one-hot. The scale factor keeps the gradient healthy. We ignore it in 2-D because the effect is tiny.

Softmax turns scores into percentages.zh: Softmax 将得分转化为百分比

Raw dot products aren't weights&mdash;th.zh:
原始点积并不是权重——它们可能为负，也可能
          极大。我们需要让它们表现得像求和为 1 的概率。

Raw dot products aren't weights&mdash;th.src: Raw dot products aren't weights—they can be negative, or gigantic. We need them to behave like probabilities that sum to one. Softmax does exactly that:

Exponentiating amplifies differences: a.zh:
取指数会放大差异：一个仅略高于其余项的得分
          会急剧上升，从而在权重中占据主导。这
          正是 softmax 被称为“软”argmax 的原因——它选出一个赢家，
          但仍向其余所有项传递非零信号。
Exponentiating amplifies differences: a.src:
Exponentiating amplifies differences: a score that's just a bit
          higher than the others rockets upward, dominating the weights. This
          is why softmax is called "soft" argmax—it picks a winner, but
          still passes non-zero signal to everyone else.

You'll see its softmax weight jump above 80% while the others shrink to single digits. Now nudge another key vector toward the query— the new word steals a huge chunk of attention even for a tiny tilt. Small changes in scores mean large changes in weights.

@@T0@@Why keys and values are kept separ.zh:
@@T0@@为何要将 key 与 value 分开。@@T1@@
          乍看之下你可能会问：为何不让 value 同时充当 key
          @@T2@@以及@@T3@@ 被平均的对象？因为那样就无法

@@T0@@Why keys and values are kept separ.src: Why keys and values are kept separate. At first glance you might ask: why not use the value as both the key and the thing to be averaged? Because then you couldn't express "attend to the word river because it's a water cue, but grab its broader geography meaning, not the raw token." Keys ask "does this match?"; values answer "here's what to contribute if I do."

Real Transformers don't loop over tokens.zh:
真实的 Transformer 并不逐个遍历词元。它们
          将全部 $N$ 个 query 堆叠为矩阵 $Q$，全部 $N$ 个 key 堆叠为 $K$，
          全部 $N$ 个 value 堆叠为 $V$，并通过
          一次矩阵乘法得出整层的输出：
Real Transformers don't loop over tokens.src:
Real Transformers don't loop over tokens one at a time. They
          stack all $N$ queries into a matrix $Q$, all $N$ keys into $K$,
          all $N$ values into $V$, and produce the entire layer output in
          a single matrix multiplication:

Here's that exact computation, run live.zh:
以下即为该计算的精确执行，实时作用于你当前
          的句子。得分矩阵 $S$ 是每个 query
          对每个 key 的表格。对每一行施加 softmax，便得到
          注意力权重矩阵 $A$。再与 $V$ 相乘，即得

Here's that exact computation, run live.src:
Here's that exact computation, run live on your current
          sentence. The score matrix $S$ is the table of every query
          against every key. Apply softmax to each row and you get the
          attention weight matrix $A$. Multiply by $V$ and you get the
          new embeddings $Y$ — one new vector per token, all in one
          matmul.

Three knobs that shape every Transformer.src: Three knobs that shape every Transformer

The clean formula above hides three desi.zh:
上面简洁的公式掩盖了三个设计选择，它们决定
          该层是有用还是失效。下面将逐一展示，并配以简短的
          交互演示。
The clean formula above hides three desi.src:
The clean formula above hides three design choices that decide
          whether the layer is useful or broken. Here they are with quick
          interactives.

Dot products of two random $d_k$-dimensi.zh:
两个随机 $d_k$ 维向量的点积
          方差为 $d_k$。随着 $d_k$ 增大，原始得分变得极大，softmax
          变得尖锐而趋于 one-hot，梯度随之消失。除以
          $\sqrt{d_k}$ 可使方差保持在 1，与宽度无关。
Dot products of two random $d_k$-dimensi.src:
Dot products of two random $d_k$-dimensional vectors have
          variance $d_k$. As $d_k$ grows, raw scores get huge, softmax
          sharpens to one-hot, and gradients vanish. Dividing by
          $\sqrt{d_k}$ keeps the variance at 1 regardless of width.

Sample of softmax weights for one query.src: Sample of softmax weights for one query against 8 random keys

Histogram of max-weight across many rand.src: Histogram of max-weight across many random queries

For a language model, the word at positi.zh:
对于语言模型，位置 $t$ 处的词不得窥视
          位置 $t+1, t+2, \dots$ — 否则训练只会教它
          复制下一个词元。我们在 softmax @@T0@@之前@@T1@@ 将这些元素
          置零，方法是给上三角区域加上 $-\infty$。
          经 softmax 后，未来的权重恰为 0。
For a language model, the word at positi.src: For a language model, the word at position $t$ must not peek at positions $t+1, t+2, \dots$ — or training would just teach it to copy the next token. We zero out those entries before the softmax by adding $-\infty$ to the upper triangle. After softmax, the future is exactly 0.

Each row's surviving weights are renorma.zh:
每行中保留下来的权重会经由 softmax 重新归一化，
          因此靠前的词元只能看到自身，下一个词元看到自身及其
          前一个词元，依此类推。正是这一技巧使
          GPT 类模型具备自回归性质。
Each row's surviving weights are renorma.src:
Each row's surviving weights are renormalised by the softmax,
          so an early token only sees itself, the next sees itself plus
          one predecessor, and so on. This single trick is what makes
          GPT-style models autoregressive.

One attention map can only express one r.zh:
一张注意力图一次只能表达一种关系。
          真实的 Transformer 并行运行 $h$ 个头 — 每个头都有
          各自的 $W_Q^{(h)}, W_K^{(h)}, W_V^{(h)}$ — 随后
          将其输出拼接。不同的头学会各自专精
          （句法、指代、位置邻接、主题）。
One attention map can only express one r.src:
One attention map can only express one relation at a time.
          Real Transformers run $h$ heads in parallel — each with
          its own $W_Q^{(h)}, W_K^{(h)}, W_V^{(h)}$ — then
          concatenate their outputs. Different heads learn to specialise
          (syntax, coreference, positional adjacency, topic).

Each head sees the same input but uses a.zh:
每个头看到的输入相同，但使用的旋转不同
          （此处我们以四个手动选取的旋转来模拟）。
          真实的多头是习得的，但其直观效果一致：它们
          关注到不同的事物。
Each head sees the same input but uses a.src:
Each head sees the same input but uses a different rotation of
          it (we simulate that here with four hand-picked rotations).
          Real heads are learned, but the visual story is the same: they
          notice different things.

Self-attention is @@T0@@permutation-inva.zh:
自注意力机制具有 @@T0@@置换不变性@@T1@@。打乱
          输入词元的顺序，输出仍是同一组新的向量，
          只是重新排列而已。对语言而言这是致命的 —
          “狗咬人”与“人咬狗”不应相同。
Self-attention is @@T0@@permutation-inva.src: Self-attention is permutation-invariant. Shuffle the order of the input tokens and the output is the same set of new vectors, just reshuffled. For language that is fatal — "dog bites man" and "man bites dog" should not be the same.

@@T0@@Quick proof.@@T1@@ Reorder the tok.zh:
@@T0@@简证。@@T1@@ 用置换 $P$ 重排 $X$ 中的
          词元。于是 $Q, K, V$ 也随之置换：$Q' = PQ$，
          $K' = PK$，$V' = PV$。新的注意力输出为
          $\mathrm{softmax}(PQ\,(PK)^\top/\sqrt{d_k})\,PV
          = P\,\mathrm{softmax}(QK^\top/\sqrt{d_k})\,V$。输出
          向量的集合完全相同，只是顺序发生了变化。
@@T0@@Quick proof.@@T1@@ Reorder the tok.src: Quick proof. Reorder the tokens in $X$ by some permutation $P$. Then $Q, K, V$ also permute: $Q' = PQ$, $K' = PK$, $V' = PV$. The new attention output is $\mathrm{softmax}(PQ\,(PK)^\top/\sqrt{d_k})\,PV = P\,\mathrm{softmax}(QK^\top/\sqrt{d_k})\,V$. The set of output vectors is identical; only their order changes.

The fix &mdash; add a position signal.zh: 解决之道 — 引入位置信号
The fix &mdash; add a position signal.src: The fix — add a position signal

Before any attention runs, the model add.zh:
在任何注意力运算开始之前，模型会为每个词元的
          嵌入加上一个位置向量
          $p_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{\text{model}}}$。Vaswani 等人的经典选择是正弦式编码：
Before any attention runs, the model add.src:
Before any attention runs, the model adds a position vector
          $p_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{\text{model}}}$ to each token's
          embedding. The classic Vaswani et al. choice is sinusoidal:

Each dimension is a sinusoid with a diff.zh:
每个维度都是波长不同的正弦曲线。
          短波长的维度用于区分相近的位置；
          长波长的维度则承载相距较远的结构。二者共同
          为每个位置赋予唯一的指纹 — 更关键的是，
          这一指纹使 @@T0@@相对@@T1@@ 位置可以被线性
          解码。
Each dimension is a sinusoid with a diff.src: Each dimension is a sinusoid with a different wavelength. The short-wavelength dimensions distinguish nearby positions; the long-wavelength ones carry far-apart structure. Together they give every position a unique fingerprint — and crucially, a fingerprint where relative position can be linearly decoded.

Sinusoidal positional encodings. Rows ar.zh:
正弦式位置编码。行表示位置，列
            表示维度。左侧波长较短，右侧
            较长。在下方控件中悬停选定某一行，即可查看某个
            位置的完整向量。
Sinusoidal positional encodings. Rows ar.src:
Sinusoidal positional encodings. Rows are positions, columns
            are dimensions. Shorter wavelengths on the left, longer on
            the right. Hover-pick a row in the controls below to see one
            position's full vector.

With vs without &mdash; permute the sent.src: With vs without — permute the sentence

Toggle the position signal on and off, t.zh:
开启或关闭位置信号，然后打乱词序。
          有位置信号时，“river bank”与“bank river”产生的
          注意力不同；无位置信号时二者完全相同。
Toggle the position signal on and off, t.src:
Toggle the position signal on and off, then shuffle the words.
          With positions, "river bank" and "bank river" produce different
          attention; without, they're identical.

Attention weights for focus token.zh: 焦点词元的注意力权重

@@T0@@Modern variants.@@T1@@ The origina.zh:
@@T0@@现代变体。@@T1@@ 原始的正弦式
          编码简单，且可外推至更长的序列。现代
          系统常采用 @@T2@@可学习@@T3@@ 嵌入（BERT）、
          @@T4@@旋转式@@T5@@ 嵌入（RoPE，用于 LLaMA 与
          DeepSeek — 它旋转 Q 与 K，而非将其加到 $X$ 上），或
          @@T6@@ALiBi@@T7@@（一种直接加到
          得分矩阵上的固定偏置）。它们解决的都是同一个问题：
          告诉注意力机制每个词元位于何处。
@@T0@@Modern variants.@@T1@@ The origina.src: Modern variants. The original sinusoidal encoding is simple and extrapolates to longer sequences. Modern systems often use learned embeddings (BERT), rotary embeddings (RoPE, used in LLaMA & DeepSeek — rotates Q and K instead of adding to $X$), or ALiBi (a fixed bias added straight to the score matrix). All solve the same problem: telling attention where each token is.

Watch a tiny attention head learn.zh: 观察一个微型注意力头的学习过程
Watch a tiny attention head learn.src: Watch a tiny attention head learn

Every Q, K, V in the article so far was.zh:
本文此前出现的每个 Q、K、V 都是为产生
          “正确”答案而手工调校的。真实的 Transformer 并不会
          凭空获得它们 — 而是通过梯度下降发现它们。现在
          让我们在浏览器中进行一次端到端的训练，反向传播全部
          手工编码。每个参数、每个梯度、每一步都写于
          纯 JavaScript 之中 — 未引入任何外部库。
Every Q, K, V in the article so far was.src:
Every Q, K, V in the article so far was hand-tuned to produce
          the "right" answer. Real Transformers don't get those for
          free — they discover them with gradient descent. Let's
          train one in your browser, end-to-end, with manually-coded
          backprop. Every parameter, every gradient, every step is in
          plain JavaScript — nothing imported.

The toy task &mdash; a soft lookup.src: The toy task — a soft lookup

We give the model a sequence of four tok.zh:
我们给模型一个含四个词元的序列。前三个
          是 @@T0@@候选@@T1@@：每个都携带 $\{A, B, C\}$ 中的 one-hot
          标识，外加一个随机的三维负载。第
          四个是 @@T2@@query@@T3@@：一个 one-hot，指明我们
          想要哪个候选的负载，其负载槽位为零。
          模型必须在该 query 位置输出对应的负载
          — 一个真正的“按名查找”问题。
We give the model a sequence of four tok.src: We give the model a sequence of four tokens. The first three are candidates: each carries a one-hot identity in $\{A, B, C\}$ plus a random 3-dim payload. The fourth is the query: a one-hot saying which candidate's payload we want, with zeros for its payload slot. The model has to output that payload at the query position — a real "look-up by name" problem.

The only learnable parameters are the th.zh:
唯一可学习的参数是三个投影
          矩阵 $W_Q$、$W_K$、$W_V$。我们将其初始化为小幅度的
          随机高斯值，在 query 位置处以均方误差为
          目标运行梯度下降，并观察损失下降。
The only learnable parameters are the th.src:
The only learnable parameters are the three projection
          matrices $W_Q$, $W_K$, $W_V$. We initialise them to small
          random Gaussians, run gradient descent on mean-squared error
          at the query position, and watch the loss fall.

Press @@T0@@Start training@@T1@@ to begi.zh: 按 @@T0@@开始训练@@T1@@ 即可开始。

Attention weights on a fixed example.zh: 固定样本上的注意力权重
Attention weights on a fixed example.src: Attention weights on a fixed example

@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@应留意的现象。@@T1@@
          大约 100 步之内，损失下降一个数量级。
          注意力图中 query 所在的一行会（几乎）跃变为
          在相匹配的候选处呈 one-hot。$W_Q$ 与 $W_K$ 起初
          随机，但很快在 id 列上长出较大的元素
          （从而使点积捕捉到相匹配的 id）；$W_V$ 则在 value
          列上长出较大的元素（从而使正确的负载得以
          传递）。没有人告诉模型“按 id 查找” —
          它自行发现了这一策略，因为这是压低损失的
          最省力方式。
@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.src: What to watch for. Within roughly 100 steps the loss drops by an order of magnitude. The query row of the attention map snaps to (almost) one-hot at the matching candidate. $W_Q$ and $W_K$ start random, but quickly grow large entries on the id columns (so the dot product picks up matching ids); $W_V$ grows large entries on the value columns (so the right payload gets carried through). Nobody told the model "look up by id" — it discovered that strategy because it's the cheapest way to drive the loss down.

Step 7 said multi-head exists; Step 9 tr.zh:
第 7 步说明了多头的存在；第 9 步训练了一个头。现在
          观察 @@T0@@两个@@T1@@ 头在同一个单头无法解决的
          任务上并排训练。每个头拥有各自的
          $W_Q, W_K, W_V$（外加一个将两者输出合并的最终线性层）。
          损失同时流经二者。
Step 7 said multi-head exists; Step 9 tr.src: Step 7 said multi-head exists; Step 9 trained one head. Now watch two heads train side-by-side on a task that a single head cannot solve. Each head gets its own $W_Q, W_K, W_V$ (and a final linear that combines the two outputs). Loss flows through both.

The sequence has four tokens: two\n.zh:
该序列有四个词元：两个
          @@T0@@A 型对@@T1@@ $(\text{key}_A, \text{val}_A)$
          与两个 @@T2@@B 型对@@T3@@ $(\text{key}_B,
          \text{val}_B)$。每个词元的输入为
          $\bigl[\text{type}\ (2)\;|\;\text{key}\ (3)\;|\;\text{val}\ (3)\bigr]$。
          query 词元（第 4 个词元）携带
          $\bigl[\text{type-A flag}\ (1)\;|\;\text{key}\ (3)\;|\;\text{type-B flag}\ (1)\;|\;\text{key}\ (3)\bigr]$，
          我们要求模型在 query 位置输出
          $\text{val}_A + \text{val}_B$。单个头
          无法将这两次查找解耦；两个头可以。
The sequence has four tokens: two\n.src: The sequence has four tokens: two type-A pairs $(\text{key}_A, \text{val}_A)$ and two type-B pairs $(\text{key}_B, \text{val}_B)$. Each token's input is $\bigl[\text{type}\ (2)\;|\;\text{key}\ (3)\;|\;\text{val}\ (3)\bigr]$. The query token (token 4) carries $\bigl[\text{type-A flag}\ (1)\;|\;\text{key}\ (3)\;|\;\text{type-B flag}\ (1)\;|\;\text{key}\ (3)\bigr]$ and we ask the model to output $\text{val}_A + \text{val}_B$ at the query position. One head can't disentangle the two lookups; two heads can.

Head A attention (on a fixed example).zh: 头 A 的注意力（固定样本）
Head A attention (on a fixed example).src: Head A attention (on a fixed example)

Head B attention (on the same example).zh: 头 B 的注意力（同一样本）
Head B attention (on the same example).src: Head B attention (on the same example)

How peaked each head is on its preferred.zh:
每个头在其偏好类型上的尖锐程度。约 80 步之后，
              随着各头分割任务，特化程度开始上升。
How peaked each head is on its preferred.src:
How peaked each head is on its preferred type. Specialisation
              rises after ~80 steps once the heads carve up the task.

@@T0@@What to watch.@@T1@@\n Wi.zh:
@@T0@@应留意的现象。@@T1@@
          在 @@T2@@两个头@@T3@@ 的情况下，损失平滑下降至接近零；
          一个头的热图聚焦于 A 型对，另一个则聚焦于
          B 型对。勾选 @@T4@@消融为单头@@T5@@，
          损失会在高得多的水平上趋于平台 — 单个注意力模式
          无法同时指向两个不同的事物。这正是
          真实的 Transformer 采用 8 个或 16 个头的实际原因。
@@T0@@What to watch.@@T1@@\n Wi.src: What to watch. With two heads the loss falls smoothly to near zero; one head's heatmap focuses on the type-A pair, the other on the type-B pair. Tick ablate to single head and the loss plateaus much higher — one attention pattern can't point at two different things at once. This is the actual reason real Transformers run 8 or 16 heads.

Run it on all five sentences.zh: 在全部五个句子上运行
Run it on all five sentences.src: Run it on all five sentences

Here's one more look at the pipeline, th.zh:
再来看一次这一流程，这次完全自动化。下方
          的表格将同一组 Q、K、V 向量（为每个歧义词预设的“合理”
          向量）代入完整的注意力公式求值，
          并显示哪个邻词占据主导。点击不同的句子，
          即可看到不同的胜出者。
Here's one more look at the pipeline, th.src:
Here's one more look at the pipeline, this time fully automated. The
          table below evaluates the same Q, K, V vectors (the pre-set "sensible"
          ones for each ambiguous word) through the entire attention formula
          and shows which neighbor dominates. Click a different sentence to
          see a different winner.

@@T0@@Observe.@@T1@@\n In every.zh:
@@T0@@观察所得。@@T1@@
          在五个句子中的每一个里，歧义词的 query 都恰好与一个
          能够为其消歧的邻词对齐。“Bank”在一种情形下倾听
          “river”，在另一种情形下倾听“money”。“Apple”则分别关注“pie”
          与“phone”。@@T2@@这正是@@T3@@ 借助注意力实现的消歧 — 没有
          手工编写的规则，只有向量的对齐。
@@T0@@Observe.@@T1@@\n In every.src: Observe. In every one of the five sentences, the ambiguous word's query lines up with exactly one neighbor that disambiguates it. "Bank" listens to "river" in one case, to "money" in another. "Apple" tunes in to "pie" versus "phone". That's disambiguation by attention—no hand-coded rules, just vector alignment.

Three things attention is @@T0@@not@@T1@.zh: 注意力机制 @@T0@@并非@@T1@@ 的三件事

@@T0@@\"Attention is just a weighted ave.zh:
@@T0@@“注意力不过是加权平均，并无新意。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              权重本身是通过 $QK^\top$ @@T3@@由数据计算得出@@T4@@
              的 — 它们依赖于每一对词元。没有任何
              静态的加权和能做到这一点。它是一个
              系数在运行时被学得的函数。
@@T0@@\"Attention is just a weighted ave.src:
"Attention is just a weighted average, nothing new."
The weights themselves are computed from the data through $QK^\top$—they depend on every pair of tokens. No static weighted sum gives you that. It's a function whose coefficients are learned on the fly.

@@T0@@\"Attention tells you what the mod.zh:
@@T0@@“注意力能告诉你模型关注什么。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              注意力权重只是深度模型内部的 @@T3@@一种@@T4@@ 信号。
              剔除一个低权重的邻词未必会改变
              预测结果，而同一个 logit 可以经由多种权重
              模式达到。将其解读为解释是有风险的。
@@T0@@\"Attention tells you what the mod.src:
"Attention tells you what the model cares about."
Attention weights are one signal inside a deep model. Cutting a low-weight neighbor doesn't necessarily change the prediction, and the same logit can be reached via many weight patterns. Reading them as explanations is risky.

@@T0@@\"Every word attends to every othe.zh:
@@T0@@“每个词对每个其他词的注意力代价相同。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              自注意力机制在序列长度上为 $O(n^2)$：句子长度加倍，
              计算量变为四倍。这正是长上下文模型
              采用各种技巧（稀疏、线性、滑动窗口）来削减开销的原因。
@@T0@@\"Every word attends to every othe.src:
"Every word attends to every other word equally in cost."
Self-attention is $O(n^2)$ in sequence length: doubling the sentence quadruples the compute. That's why long-context models use tricks (sparse, linear, sliding-window) to cut this down.

What we still swept under the rug.zh: 我们仍然略去未谈的内容
What we still swept under the rug.src: What we still swept under the rug

You've now seen every number of one head.zh:
至此你已看到单头、单层，含位置编码、含掩码、
          含多头、含训练的每一个数值。
          真实的 Transformer 还有更多：
You've now seen every number of one head.src:
You've now seen every number of one head, one layer, with
          positions, with masking, with multi-head, and with training.
          A real Transformer keeps going:

@@T0@@Many stacked layers.@@T1@@ The out.zh:
@@T0@@多层堆叠。@@T1@@ 一个
            注意力块的输出成为下一块的输入。经过若干
            层之后，“bank”所承载的含义由横跨整个句子的
            @@T2@@推理链@@T3@@ 塑造而成。ViT-Base 堆叠 12 层，
            GPT-3 堆叠 96 层，据报道 GPT-4 更多。
@@T0@@Many stacked layers.@@T1@@ The out.src: Many stacked layers. The output of one attention block becomes the input to the next. After a few layers, "bank" carries meaning shaped by chains of inference across the whole sentence. ViT-Base stacks 12, GPT-3 stacks 96, GPT-4 reportedly more.

@@T0@@Residual streams + LayerNorm.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@残差流 + LayerNorm。@@T1@@ 每个块都被包裹为
            $x \leftarrow x + \mathrm{Attn}(x)$，随后接一个
            LayerNorm 和一个 MLP。残差使信息可以原封不动地
            跨层传递，如今它被认为正是模型写入其上的
            “记忆带”。
@@T0@@Residual streams + LayerNorm.@@T1@.src: Residual streams + LayerNorm. Each block is wrapped in $x \leftarrow x + \mathrm{Attn}(x)$ followed by a LayerNorm and an MLP. The residual lets information skip unchanged through layers and is now believed to be the actual "memory tape" the model writes onto.

@@T0@@Cross-attention.@@T1@@ In encoder-.zh:
@@T0@@交叉注意力。@@T1@@ 在编码器-解码器模型
            （翻译、T5、图像到文本）中，$Q$ 来自解码器，
            而 $K, V$ 来自编码器 — 解码器
            “询问源端”而非询问自身。在机制上是同一个
            公式。
@@T0@@Cross-attention.@@T1@@ In encoder-.src: Cross-attention. In encoder-decoder models (translation, T5, image-to-text), $Q$ comes from the decoder but $K, V$ come from the encoder — the decoder "asks the source" instead of itself. Mechanically the same formula.

@@T0@@Efficient attention.@@T1@@ $O(N^2).zh:
@@T0@@高效注意力。@@T1@@ $O(N^2)$ 在
            长上下文下会急剧膨胀。FlashAttention 重排矩阵乘法以适配
            SRAM；滑动窗口（Mistral）、稀疏（Longformer）、
            状态空间（Mamba）以及线性注意力（Linformer）
            等变体则牺牲少许表达力，换取 $O(N)$ 或
            $O(N \log N)$ 的复杂度。
@@T0@@Efficient attention.@@T1@@ $O(N^2).src: Efficient attention. $O(N^2)$ blows up at long context. FlashAttention reorders the matmul to fit in SRAM; sliding-window (Mistral), sparse (Longformer), state-space (Mamba), and linear-attention (Linformer) variants trade a little expressivity for $O(N)$ or $O(N \log N)$.

@@T0@@KV cache for inference.@@T1@@ When.zh:
@@T0@@推理时的 KV 缓存。@@T1@@ 当聊天机器人
            逐个词元地生成文本时，此前所有词元的 key 与 value
            都会被缓存并重复使用。在生产部署中，这一缓存
            占据了 GPU 显存的大部分。
@@T0@@KV cache for inference.@@T1@@ When.src: KV cache for inference. When a chatbot generates text token by token, the keys and values of all previous tokens are cached and reused. That cache is most of what fills GPU memory in production deployments.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n S.zh:
@@T0@@最后总结。@@T1@@
          自注意力机制是 Transformer 用来询问
          “我该倾听哪些邻词？”的通用方式。你刚刚手工
          计算了这一答案的每一个步骤 — 从产生 Q、K、V 的
          投影矩阵，到矩阵形式的
          softmax，到位置信息的修正，再到在一个真实的玩具任务上
          运行梯度下降。将这一运算在深度与宽度上堆叠起来，
          配以残差、MLP 以及十亿级词元的训练集，便是
          从原始词元构建出 GPT 级理解力的方式。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n S.src: Final takeaway. Self-attention is a Transformer's universal way of asking "which neighbors should I listen to?" You just computed every step of that answer by hand — from the projection matrices that produce Q, K, V, through the matrix-form softmax, through positional fixes, through gradient descent on a real toy. Stacking this operation in depth and width, with residuals, MLPs, and a billion-token training set, is what builds GPT-level understanding from raw tokens.

meta.title: 注意力机制的精算
meta.tagline: 从 Q/K/V 投影出发，到在浏览器中实时训练的微型注意力头
meta.summary: 十二个交互步骤：从单词歧义一路走到软查找任务上的手工反向传播 — 涵盖矩阵形式的注意力、缩放点积、因果掩码、多头、正弦式位置编码，以及一个重排句子的演示。
highlights: 看 Q、K、V 从何而来 — 点击一个词元，观察其 4 维嵌入经由 W_Q、W_K、W_V 推出 2 维 query/key/value 向量。
实时检视完整的 N×N 矩阵形式注意力（得分 → softmax → 加权 V），适用于六个歧义句中的任意一个。
三旋钮演练场：缩放点积（对 d_k 的滑块，配 softmax 尖锐度直方图）、因果掩码、四路并行多头注意力图。
正弦式位置编码热图，配有 T 与 d 的滑块，以及一个“重排句子”演示，说明注意力为何需要位置信息。
在浏览器中端到端观察一个微型注意力头学习软查找任务 — 纯 JS 手工反向传播，损失曲线与注意力热图实时演化。

Same input embedding, three rotations, t.zh: 相同的输入嵌入，三种旋转，三种角色。
Same input embedding, three rotations, t.src: Same input embedding, three rotations, three roles.

Average peak weight across 500 random dr.zh: 500 次随机采样下的平均峰值权重：@@T0@@[[[0]]]%@@T1@@
Average peak weight across 500 random dr.src: Average peak weight across 500 random draws: ${(avgMax * 100).toFixed(1)}%

the query row should peak at column @@T0.zh: query 所在行应在第 @@T0@@c[[[0]]]@@T1@@ 列处达到峰值。
the query row should peak at column @@T0.src: the query row should peak at column c${ex.targetSlot + 1}.
